title: A menu from what is already at home
description: Plan dishes around leftovers, portions and what the family likes. Shop from one shared list.

blocks.text: The author of the next review values a plan of recipes, a shopping list and a count of what is in stock. This is the scenario of preparing food before a meal, one that an ordinary log of what was eaten does not cover.

quote.text: This app was exactly what I was looking for… automated recipe planning with automatic grocery list building based off your week, pantry management, and syncs with Apple health for tracking.

blocks.text: Link the menu to the shopping

Draw up a plan for the chosen days, taking into account the number of servings and the ingredients already in the house. When a dish is swapped, recalculate the shopping list without creating an entry for food supposedly eaten. What is left of the cooking can be offered for the next day.
Check whether people keep the stock list up to date
If every plan requires describing the whole fridge from scratch, the saving disappears. To begin with, it is worth testing a few usual dishes and a short list of leftovers that are genuinely known.
